functions.name: best
functions.description: Find the best matching items from a list, sorted by score descending. Items with score 0 are excluded.

params.name: max_results
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

returns.name: results
returns.description: Array of matching strings (caller must free)

functions.name: contains_ci
functions.description: Check if a string contains a substring (case-insensitive).

functions.name: distance
functions.description: Compute Levenshtein edit distance between two strings. The edit distance is the minimum number of single-character edits (insertions, deletions, substitutions) required to transform one string into another.

functions.name: matches
functions.description: Check if query approximately matches target within a similarity threshold.

functions.name: score
functions.description: Compute a fuzzy match score combining multiple matching strategies. Higher scores indicate better matches. Returns 0 if no match. Scoring:   - Exact match: 1000   - Prefix match: 500 + (query_len / target_len * 100)   - Substring match: 300 + (query_len / target_len * 100)   - Word boundary match (after _ or at start): 200   - Similarity match (>= 0.6): similarity * 100

returns.name: score
returns.description: Match score (0 = no match, higher = better)

functions.name: similarity
functions.description: Compute similarity between two strings as a value from 0.0 to 1.0. 1.0 means identical, 0.0 means completely different. Based on normalized Levenshtein distance: 1 - (distance / max_length).

functions.name: starts_with_ci
functions.description: Check if a string starts with a given prefix (case-insensitive).

returns.name: starts
returns.description: 1 if s starts with prefix, 0 otherwise
